briefdescription.para: Performance benchmark tests for LLM Wiki plugin (LWP-PERF-01).

detaileddescription.para:
Validates performance characteristics:
Benchmark query performance with 5k-chunk workspace
Measure p95/p99 latency distribution
Ensure sub-200ms p95 latency (target: 150ms p95)
Use realistic query patterns (single-term, multi-term, phrase)
Verify memory stability across 1000+ queries
Success Criteria: ✓ P95 latency < 200ms for all query patterns ✓ P99 latency < 500ms ✓ Memory usage stable across 1000+ queries (no leaks) ✓ Benchmark reproducible (same latency ±10%)
